skill.name: patterns
skill.description: Loads project-specific code patterns and abstraction guidance so implementation work follows existing conventions.
skill.summary: Helps assistants apply project code patterns before implementation.
skill.author: Clouder0

security_audit.summary: The audit found no static security findings in this prompt-only skill. Manual review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection, credential access, network behavior, executable code, or data exfiltration intent. No remediation is required.

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when generated code ignores established repository conventions. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code load project pattern guidance before implementation.
actual_capabilities: Directs the assistant to load common project code patterns before implementation.
Lists feature, component, abstraction, and structure decisions as suitable triggers.
Points to a project pattern reference at memory/knowledge/codebase/patterns.json.
Covers data access, API, component, state, and error handling pattern categories.
Limits declared tool access to Read and Grep.
limitations: Does not include the referenced patterns.json file in this package.
Does not execute code, modify files, or validate pattern correctness by itself.
Requires the host project to maintain accurate pattern documentation.
May be too generic for repositories without the referenced memory path.

use_cases.title: Feature Implementation Consistency
use_cases.description: Load project patterns before adding a feature so new code follows established abstractions.

use_cases.title: Architecture Review Preparation
use_cases.description: Compare an implementation plan with documented data, API, component, state, and error handling patterns.

use_cases.title: Onboarding To Local Conventions
use_cases.description: Help new contributors understand which project patterns should guide their first implementation tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Load Basic Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task before a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: Load the patterns skill and summarize the project patterns I should follow before implementing this feature: [feature].

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for UI or service work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the patterns skill to plan a new [component or service]. Identify relevant component, state, API, and error handling patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Review An Existing Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the patterns skill to review this implementation plan for consistency with established project abstractions: [plan].

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Pattern Tradeoffs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task when multiple approaches fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the patterns skill to compare viable approaches for [task]. Recommend the option that best matches current project patterns.

output_examples.input: Implement a new settings page using existing project patterns.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks pattern guidance, then identifies component, state, and error handling conventions to follow.

output_examples.input: Review a service design before implementation.
output_examples.output: The assistant compares the plan with data access and API design patterns, then flags mismatches for revision.

output_examples.input: Help a new contributor understand the repository style.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes the pattern categories and explains which conventions matter for the contributor's task.

best_practices: Run it before editing code when a task must match existing conventions.
Combine it with targeted file reading to confirm that pattern guidance is current.
Ask for tradeoffs when a requested design conflicts with established patterns.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the referenced pattern file as a source of security approval.
Do not apply patterns blindly when nearby code uses a newer convention.
Do not use it to override explicit repository instructions or user requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps an assistant load project code patterns before implementing or reviewing changes.

faq.question: Does this skill include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill is prompt-only and declares Read and Grep as allowed tools.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What pattern areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It names data access, API design, component, state management, and error handling patterns.

faq.question: Does it provide the referenced patterns file?
faq.answer: No. It points to memory/knowledge/codebase/patterns.json, which must exist in the host project.

faq.question: Should it replace repository instructions?
faq.answer: No. It should support repository instructions, user requirements, and current source code evidence.
